threads.body: `on_tool_end` currently overwrites an id captured at `on_tool_start` whenever a truthy `output.tool_call_id` is present. If the end id disagrees with the start id, this will silently replace the original and can break correlation with earlier events. Consider only setting the end id when `tool_invocation.tool_call_id` is not already set, or only overwriting when the values match (and otherwise keep the start id / optionally log a debug warning).

replies.body: fixed this, now it won't be overwritten if `tool_invocation.tool_call_id` already has value

+def test_on_tool_error_records_tool_call_id_from_start(monkeypatch):
+    """A failing tool still records ``gen_ai.tool.call.id`` when the id is

+
+    run_id = uuid4()
+    handler.on_tool_start(
+        serialized={"name": "failing_tool"},
+        input_str="bad input",
+        run_id=run_id,
+        tool_call_id="call_abc",
+    )
+    handler.on_tool_error(error=RuntimeError("boom"), run_id=run_id)
+
+    spans = span_exporter.get_finished_spans()
+    assert len(spans) == 1
+    span = spans[0]
+    attrs = span.attributes
+    assert attrs[gen_ai_attributes.GEN_AI_TOOL_CALL_ID] == "call_abc"
+    assert attrs[error_attributes.ERROR_TYPE] == "RuntimeError"
+    assert span.status.status_code.name == "ERROR"
+
